faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Project Scientist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting applications for the Project Scientist post at IIT Delhi is 27 August 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Scientist at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Project Scientist position under the IIT Delhi recruitment drive. This offers a good opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Delhi Project Scientist posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Scientist recruitment at IIT Delhi is via Email. Candidates need to send their resume and required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Scientist position at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Scientist post at IIT Delhi will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 47790 to Rs. 62350 per month, along with HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Scientist?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, ECE, Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, with relevant professional/research experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Delhi Project Scientist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Project Scientist recruitment at IIT Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Project Scientist at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Scientist position at IIT Delhi involves shortlisting of applications followed by an online interview for the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Project Scientist be posted?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist position is based in New Delhi, Delhi, specifically at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi campus.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for recruitment related information at IIT Delhi is http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec. Candidates can visit this site for detailed notifications and updates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The Project Scientist position at IIT Delhi is a Contractual job type. This offers a fixed-term engagement for the selected candidates.
